insights.headline: Union Gold has $7.0K in the bank, about a day of its recent spending
insights.detail: Union Gold's own checking holds $7,037.47 after $2.2K went out in November. It paid out an average of $191.5K a month from August to October with almost nothing coming in, so at that pace the cash lasts about a day (well under a week) and it needs funding now. Its $2.66M Umicore receivable and $2M due from MW Platoro are not cash.

insights.headline: Umicore's $2.66M Stock Purchase Agreement receivable is still unpaid and over 90 days old
insights.detail: The whole $2.66M owed by Umicore USA sits in the 91+ day bucket. It is Union Gold's largest current asset. Collecting it would cover more than a year of Union Gold's recent spending.

insights.headline: MW Sorter is down to $769 in the bank with $577.9K of bills over 90 days
insights.detail: Cash fell from $9.0K at the end of October to $768.92 after $8.2K went out in November. Bills over 90 days include the $310K owed to MineWater, $170.9K of county property taxes (Gunnison $129.6K, Park $33.6K, Saguache $7.8K), Ocean Partners ($35.9K) and DRMS ($23.1K). Total payables are $733.3K, including a $42.0K Red Rocks Insurance bill.

insights.headline: Union Gold now owes $45.6K to vendors, including MineWater's $32.5K invoice
insights.detail: Union Gold recorded MineWater's October invoice ($32,506.86, due Nov 30), so the two companies' books now agree on it. With $7.0K in the bank, Union Gold cannot pay its open bills without new funding. Its other open bills are DA Wilson Electric ($12,710) and Sangre de Cristo Lab ($380).

insights.headline: MW Platoro's two CDs ($785.9K) are still in Union Gold's QuickBooks file
insights.detail: CDs x8665 ($185.9K) and x8668 ($600K) were added to Union Gold's file on Nov 4 with opening balances. They belong to MW Platoro and were closed into its Chase account on Oct 30, so they are left out of Union Gold's cash here. They should be removed from Union Gold's file.

insights.headline: MineWater and MW Sorter disagree by $600K on the pre-2025 loan balance
insights.detail: MW Sorter shows $1.26M of "MineWater LLC Loans (as of 12/31/2024)", while MineWater shows $663.1K due from MW Sorter for the same period; their post-2024 balances also differ ($143.4K at MineWater vs $127.3K at MW Sorter). MineWater carries $183.6K of "Advances from Union Gold Inc – 8%" with no matching balance in Union Gold's books, and MineWater shows $973 due to Happy Union Venture while Happy Union Venture records a $10K MineWater capital contribution instead. The $358K of management fees, MW Platoro's $2M owed to Union Gold and the $1M Happy Union Venture loan agree on both sides.

insights.headline: MW Platoro paid $43.4K to Swan Energy – Eureka Joint Venture on Nov 5
insights.detail: This new payment is booked as an investment, bringing MW Platoro's investment payments this year to $93.4K, and cash is now $908.0K, down from $951.4K at the end of October. Its CDs were closed on Oct 30 with $12.3K of interest, after a $3.5K early-withdrawal penalty in August. The largest outflow this year was the $1M loan to Happy Union Venture, and MW Platoro still owes Union Gold $2M.

insights.headline: Happy Union Venture holds $112.9K, with no new activity in November
insights.detail: Its books start in October. Cash in was $143.3K: $117.6K of gold-sale proceeds passed over from MineWater and a $25.7K direct gold sale. Cash out was $30.4K, almost all a $30K payment to Violetta Queen recorded as a Happy Shine distribution. Net income is $142.9K.

insights.headline: MineWater took in $2.31M and paid out $2.36M this year
insights.detail: Customer payments brought in $1.63M. The largest outflows were payroll ($571K), vendor bills ($456K) and the legal settlement ($400K). Cash is $161.8K; November 1–10 shows $27.3K out and almost nothing in, including $12.0K to Xcel Energy and $6.0K to SilverBrook Engineering.

insights.headline: MW Sorter runs on related-party funding; QuickBooks' cash-flow statement overstates it
insights.detail: $135.5K of MW Sorter's $140.8K cash in came from related parties. Its bank cash fell $14.1K this year, while QuickBooks' own cash-flow statement shows $1.52M used in operations because it counts non-cash interest and loan entries.
